description: Disposition of every supported cell in the Advisor method x target matrix. Section 8 of docs/sql-server-to-azure-migration.md marks each supported (method, target) cell.md marks 51 (method, target) cells as supported. Each one must appear here exactly once with a status, so that a route the Advisor can recommend can never silently lack prerequisite coverage. Enforced by tests/check-prerequisite-skill.mjs. Each cell also carries an advisorRole that separates "supported" from "recommendable": tests/run-tests.mjs requires every primary and secondary cell to appear in the matching target sub-section of reference/decision-rules.md B3.

statuses.path: Covered by one or more prerequisite paths in this catalog.
statuses.out-of-scope: Deliberately excluded. The reason must explain why this cell is not a SQL Server to Azure data-movement route.
